Domain.title: Safe Use of Public Computers and Wi-Fi
Verifying Online Identities and Combating Catfishing

TopFactors.Factor: Enhancing Social Media Privacy Settings: Open profiles, tagging, and location visibility increase exposure.
Verifying Online Identities and Combating Catfishing: Accepting unknowns without checks invites scams/abuse.
Managing Your Digital Footprint: Large, stable footprints make targeting easier.

QuickWins.Win: Set profiles to friends-only; disable location and public tagging.
Reverse-image search and cross-check handles before engaging.
Quarterly cleanup: prune old posts; remove data-broker listings.
